[EVENT] User asked about setting up a separate enclosure for Mr. Cluckers to give him more social interaction with the hens.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided guidance on creating a separate enclosure for Mr. Cluckers, including reasons for separation (aggression, stress, social interaction).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended a minimum enclosure size of 4x4 feet (1.2x1.2 meters) and suggested using sturdy, predator-proof fencing material.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised on gradual introductions between Mr. Cluckers and the hens, monitoring behavior, and providing enrichment.  
[EVENT] User asked about cleaning the new watering system installed in the chicken coop to prevent bacterial growth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a step-by-step guide for cleaning the watering system, including materials needed and cleaning steps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed materials needed: bucket, mild dish soap or poultry-safe cleaning product, warm water, soft-bristled brush, scrubber, clean water source, and sanitizer (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant detailed cleaning steps: disconnect and drain, remove debris, mix cleaning solution, soak and scrub, rinse thoroughly, sanitize (optional), reassemble and refill.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended cleaning the watering system at least once a week and monitoring for signs of wear or damage.
